content:
The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 was on **December 25, 1999**. This was a partial solar eclipse that was visible from parts of North America, including the eastern United States and eastern Canada.

If you're looking specifically for the last *total* solar eclipse before 2000, that occurred on **February 26, 1998**, and was visible across parts of the Pacific Ocean, Central America, and northern South America.
